description: This file contains pytest test cases for testing FastAPI application endpoints related to login functionality, including form data validation, response assertions, and API schema verification.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameters, initializes a FastAPI TestClient for that module's app, and yields it for use in tests.

methods.name: test_post_body_form(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /login/ endpoint with form data containing username and password, expecting a 200 response with the same data in JSON.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_password(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests missing password in form data, expecting a 422 validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_username(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests missing username in form data, expecting a 422 validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_data(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting no data to the /login/ endpoint, expecting validation errors for both fields.

methods.name: test_post_body_json(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests submitting form data as JSON, expecting a 422 validation error due to missing required fields (since endpoint expects form data).

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Fetches and verifies the OpenAPI schema JSON from the /openapi.json endpoint, ensuring correct API documentation.
